title: Stubs and Fakes
description: Differentiate between mocks, stubs, and fakes.

data.text: **Stubs, fakes, and mocks** are all test doubles, but they serve different purposes. Understanding the differences helps you choose the right tool.

items: Stub – Provides canned responses, no behavior verification
Fake – Working implementation for testing (e.g., in-memory database)
Mock – Expects specific interactions and verifies them

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Choose the appropriate test double based on your testing needs.
